# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m154 and package docs**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and ships XML API documentation with NuGet packages. Package consumers can now receive compiler XML documentation, including API remarks authored in the C# source, alongside the managed assemblies.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates upstream m154 bug fixes, including a buffer-upload fix. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **XML API documentation ships with packages** — Managed NuGet packages now include compiler XML documentation generated from C# API comments, improving IntelliSense and consumer-facing API reference content. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
